3641-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
3641-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1849-2023-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2353-4691-6036.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
You control an Angel.
2353-4691-6036.description:
Activate Book of Exalted Deeds by paying {W}{W}{W}, tapping it, and exiling it, giving an Angel you control an ability that prevents you from losing the game this turn.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until your library is empty.

728-978--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

603-3899-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
603-3899-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat from step 2.

4038-4613-7426-7852.easyPrerequisites:
There is at least one +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta does not have summoning sickness.
4038-4613-7426-7852.description:
Activate Berta using Phantom Nantuko's ability by tapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Berta using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3010-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3010-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-3099-6723-7060.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2034-5224-6294-7729.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {2}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Marketback Walker, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1169-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6965-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-6248-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-6248-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4460-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

465-3175-5231.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Repeat from step 3.

2604-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2604-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
You control another Merfolk and/or Knight.
3532-4997-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and/or Knight you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1170-5078-6289-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-5078-6289-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

640-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

640-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
640-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2474-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and City on Fire.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2058-2073-2829.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Flayer Husk.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1082-2034-4499-6521.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if a Hare Apparent is in your hand or {3} otherwise
1082-2034-4499-6521.description:
If you have a Hare Apparent in your hand, cast it by paying {1}{W}. If not, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking a Hare Apparent.
When Hare Apparent enters the battlefield, it and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Hare Apparent.
When the Hare Apparent token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens equal to the amount of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
Resolve the Hare Apparent trigger from step 2, creating a number of 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens equal to the amount of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Rabbits, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking a nontoken Hare Apparent.
Hare Apparent, Dual Nature's first ability and Dual Nature's second ability trigger.
Resolve the first Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Hare Apparent.
Repeat from step 4.
1082-2034-4499-6521.notes: You should not resolve the Dual Nature second ability triggers. This allows you to continually get more and more Hare Apparents, allowing you to make more Rabbits each iteration.

1020-2866-4030-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

372-3086-4200.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-3086-4200.description:
Cast Lagrella either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{W}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Lagrella.
Lagrella leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Lagrella.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3443-4824-6287.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Soliton and Deathbloom Ritualist are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
3443-4824-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1940-5231-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1940-5231-6249--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

2079-2933-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

500-914-4823.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
500-914-4823.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Dockside Extortionist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate ten Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{B}{B}{G}{G}.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Timeless Witness and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Timeless Witness tokens enter the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
If opponents control six or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2493-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2493-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Displace to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1961-3490-4853-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
1961-3490-4853-5296.description:
Activate Thrnoe of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
The artifact creature dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Throne of Geth.
Resolve the Throne of Geth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

396-1558-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least four descent counters on it.
396-1558-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus, and causing each opponent to be dealt an amount of damage equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
